name: B10-0186/2024 (The Left) – The increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Iran to stop repressing women. It asks Iran to let women choose whether to wear a veil, release people held for their beliefs or for speaking out, protect girls' education and end the death penalty. It also asks European Union countries to offer more humanitarian visas to persecuted women. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The text asks Iran to change its laws and practices; it does not itself change anything.
- It affects women, minorities and human rights defenders in Iran, and European visa policy.
- Next, the Parliament sends its demands to Iran, European Union bodies and the United Nations.
